sanitize_proxy_path: sanitize a proxy path string to prevent directory traversal and SSRF attacks
list_terminal_servers: list all terminal servers the authenticated user has access to via the GET endpoint
proxy_terminal_request: proxy an HTTP request to an admin-configured terminal server by server ID and path
resolve_authenticated_ws_connection: authenticate a WebSocket connection using first-message JWT auth and resolve the terminal server
proxy_websocket_terminal: proxy an interactive WebSocket terminal session to an upstream terminal server with bidirectional message forwarding
